feeds.title: Cuddle Professionals International Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Official Blog of Cuddle Professionals International. Cuddle Professionals International runs certified and accredited training courses. Cuddle Professionals is the training, accreditation and membership body for platonic touch therapists.

feeds.title: Cuddle Santuary Blog
feeds.description: Visit the blog and stay up to date with the posts from Cuddle Sanctuary and find advice on cuddle therapy. Cuddle Sanctuary's mission is to shift the culture to a more compassionate world that's safe for affection and connection for everyone.

feeds.title: Cuddle Jen Blog
feeds.description: Find out everything you need to know about Cuddle Therapy with the Cuddle Jen Blog. Cuddle Jen will hold you, cuddle you, and show you a kinder, gentler way to treat the most important person in your life. She has calmed many new parents, single parents, school-age children, colleagues, sex addicts, porn addicts, sex offenders, and dozens of other humans with a simple 20-second heart hug.

feeds.title: Kuschel Raum Blog
feeds.description: Get inspired by our cuddling blog and learn about cuddle therapy with Kuschel Raum. Engaging with touch is a transformative, profound process that empowers one to actively shape intimacy and live a more meaningful life. That's why we want to create a continuously growing Germany and Europe-wide network in the Kuschel Raum, in which people can come together to experience, learn and offer conscious, loving touch.

feeds.title: Cuddle Party Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Cuddle Party Blog to learn about the benefits of cuddling, consent, cuddle parties and much more. Cuddle Party INC. is a non-profit charitable organization. Our mission and purpose is to promote and enable empowered consent, choice and nurturing touch. We do this by training and certifying facilitators who produce Cuddle Parties and other related events.

feeds.title: Trevor James Blog
feeds.description: Read Trevor James' Blog for professional cuddling advice and much more related to cuddle therapy. Trevor James is a Certified Touch and Cuddle Therapist, Intimacy and Connection Coach, and 'Dr. Cuddles'. Dr. Cuddles is a professional cuddle service for men who may be touch- or affection-deprived, including those with depression, loneliness, and intimacy issues.

feeds.title: Cuddle Companion Blog
feeds.description: Get to know about the best Cuddle service for professional cuddlers, cuddle therapy, snuggle buddies, massage therapists, and travel buddies. Find out about cuddlers near you and learn all about Cuddle Companion! We help you meet amazing cuddle companions near you and around the world with Cuddle Companions!

feeds.title: Touchunwind Blog
feeds.description: Visit the Touchunwind Blog to know about holistic health, alternative touch medicine and the power of healing touch and cuddles. I'm Kristiina and I've been a cuddle therapist for the past 4 years now and believe in the healing power of cuddling and platonic touching.

feeds.title: Cuddle Career Blog
feeds.description: The Cuddle Career Blog provides free helpful resources to start and grow your heart-centered professional cuddling business. Here at Cuddle Career, we focus on building a sustainable cuddle business so you can keep changing lives through the work you love.

feeds.title: Cuddlist Blog
feeds.description: Learn about Cuddle Therapy, professional cuddle coach training, and much more from Cuddlist. Cuddlist is a collaboration between Adam Lippin, a conscious entrepreneur, and Madelon Guinazzo, a consent expert. Cuddlist brings together those who need healthy meaningful connection with trained, professional practitioners who are experienced, safe, well-versed in consent and follow a code of conduct that sets the conditions for a great session.
